title: Target is eliminating 1,800 corporate jobs as it looks to reclaim its lost lustre
summary: Target said Thursday that it is eliminating about 1,800 corporate positions in an effort to streamline decision-making and accelerate initiatives to rebuild the flagging discount retailer’s customer base.
